name: Shikokuchūō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shikokuchūō city emblem in orange, light blue and green: an orange sun within light blue and green swirling strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Shikokuchūō, a city in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2004.
